title: comfyrizz.package/v1
description: Comfyrizz package document (SPEC.md 6.3). A package is the deterministic input of the timeline compiler and the renderer, and the record of how every asset was obtained. Structural rules live here; cross-field rules (unique ids, resolvable refs, relative paths only, licence/rights separation, layout limits) live in the shared semantic validator implemented identically in TypeScript (src/semantic.mjs) and Python (pipeline-py/comfyrizz_pipeline/schema.py). Generated-first assets (PLAN.md 'Generated-first assets'): asset kind svg / vector-anim, gen.generator in llm-svg | flux3-klein | ltx25 | kokoro | qwen3-tts, gen.sanitizer_version, gen.render_check, output licence defaults to CC0-1.0 with redistributable true.

$schema.description: Documentation URL of the schema this document was written against. Deliberately not checked as a URI: the scaffolded placeholder in SPEC.md 6.3 is a literal example and must be filled in before release.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the comfyrizz.package schema this document conforms to.

revision.description: Monotonic package revision. Bumped by every accepted edit; a later render must record the revision it used.

id.description: Stable package id. Google Colab session names are derived from it (comfyrizz-<id>).

targetFrames.description: Required for mode target. Integer frames at format.fps.

flexibleCeilingFrames.description: Documented ceiling of flexible mode (SPEC.md 6.8, PLAN.md A2).

text.description: Primary text colour. Without it the renderer falls back to palette[0], which a media scene may set to 'transparent' (P-fix1).

engine.description: kokoro (default) is the CPU narrator. qwen3-tts is the optional Qwen3-TTS 1.7B backend; when its runtime is missing the pipeline falls back to kokoro unless voice.strict is true. none disables narration.

lang.description: Optional short language tag for Qwen3-TTS (en or fr). When it is omitted, voice.language is used. Kokoro keeps using voice.language.

persona.description: Natural-language narrator description. Qwen3-TTS VoiceDesign uses it once per package to build the cloned voice.

ref_asset.description: Designed reference clip for the package narrator (CC0, because we generated it). Optional; the synth caches a voice_clone_prompt either way.

strict.description: When true, a selected qwen3-tts runtime that is unavailable fails the run. When false or omitted, the run falls back to Kokoro.

chunking.description: Kokoro synthesis context: separate sentences (default) or a coherent scene paragraph with estimated sentence/word alignment.

blend.description: Kokoro weighted voice styles. Positive weights are normalized before synthesis.

qwen_mode.description: design (default) uses VoiceDesign then Base cloning; custom uses the CustomVoice preset named in voice.voice.

delivery.description: CustomVoice default delivery instruction, overridden by scene.narration_style. For design mode, appended to the reference persona.

non_streaming.description: Qwen full-text conditioning. Defaults to false for Base cloning and true for CustomVoice.

reference_text.description: Transcript synthesized by VoiceDesign to create the reusable synthetic reference.

cast.description: CAST1: recurring characters. Optional. A package without this array validates, plans and renders exactly as before. A member is fictional by default; a real_authorized member is allowed only with a consentRef (CCL5b).

easingToken.description: MS2: a named ease, exactly the keys of EASING_TOKENS in apps/renderer/src/motion/index.js (MS1). `linear` is only for continuous motion, never an entrance.

springPreset.description: MS2: a spring preset, exactly the keys of SPRING_PRESETS (MS1). `elastic` is an accent: at most once per video.

motionEnergy.description: MS2: an energy profile, exactly the keys of ENERGY_PROFILES (MS1). Scales entries, stagger and travel; picks the transition family.

motionDirection.description: MS2: the direction content travels in (vector law). The package direction is the film's one current for ordinary 'next point' cuts; `up` is reserved for a conclusion.

transitionType.description: MS2 transition vocabulary. none/cut: no overlap; fade/blur: calm crossfades; slide/push/wipe: directional (medium); zoom/iris: in/out (high); paper-reveal/draw-reveal/shape-reveal: no-axis reveal transitions for the storytelling recipes. The first four of the original enum (none, fade, slide, wipe) keep their meaning.

transitionDirection.description: MS2: direction of a transition. left/right/up/down for slide, push and wipe; in/out for zoom (in = deeper, out = arrival) and iris (in = closes, out = opens).

presenter.description: H17: the AI presenter, generated with LTX-2.5 audio-to-video from a portrait still and each scene's narration. Opt-in per video: a package without this renders exactly as before, and `enabled: false` means the same thing as leaving it out. `scenes` is what the presenter covers - bookends (intro plus outro) is the intended default when it is on.

portrait.description: The portrait still: an asset id, or a CAST1 cast id whose ready ref_asset is that still. A cast id is the optional hook that lets the portrait be a cast member without requiring any other presenter field.

cast.description: CAST1: this presenter is the cast member. Optional. When portrait is an asset id, jobs for that still append the member's ref_asset. When portrait is a cast id, the portrait is that member's ref_asset.

size.description: the presenter's width as a fraction of the frame's short side (research 2.2: 18-32 %)

scenes.description: which scenes show the presenter: both bookends, every scene, or the scene ids the agent chose (the cheap knob is coverage, not stitching)

label.description: the corner chip's text, when one is drawn

packageMotion.description: MS2: film-wide motion direction. Optional; a package without it renders as energy medium, direction left.

style.description: K1: caption presentation. sentence is the default; when style is absent a 9:16 video defaults to big-word and everything else to sentence.

packageCaptions.description: K1: caption presentation. Optional; absent means sentence, except a 9:16 video defaults to big-word.

packageAudio.description: M1: the film's sound design - a music bed, LTX plate ambience and short sound effects, all mixed under the narration with sidechain-style ducking. Optional and additive: a package without this block renders exactly as before.

music.description: A background music bed under the narration. `asset` names a ready audio asset; a missing or not-ready asset is a semantic error, not a silent skip.

gain_db.description: Bed level before ducking. -18 dB is the intended default under narration.

loop.description: Loop the bed if it is shorter than the video; the fade-out still applies at the end.

ambience.description: LTX plate audio (an asset with media.audio: present) mixed under the narration. -24 LUFS-ish, ducked.

sfx.description: Short sound effects at scene seams, timed to the MS3 transition. Each names a ready audio asset and the scene it belongs to.

audioDuck.description: M1: sidechain-style ducking under the narration. Defaults mirror a typical sidechaincompress: -12 dB of gain reduction, 20 ms attack, 300 ms release.

reduction_db.description: How far the bed/ambience is pushed down while the narration speaks.

scene.description: The scene whose seam the sound belongs to. scene-start is the scene's first frame; scene-end/transition is its out-transition.

diagram.description: List-layout motion diagram: connected step cards or a shared hub. Copy stays editable.

recipe.description: Storytelling recipe for this scene. Optional: an absent recipe means the renderer keeps its current layout/default behaviour. The shared catalogue is packages/schema/src/animation.mjs ANIMATION_RECIPES.

seed.description: Stable seed for the recipe's generated texture/geometry. Omitted: the renderer's own deterministic default.

intensity.description: Recipe strength, 0..1. Omitted: the recipe's default.

x.description: Left edge as a fraction of the frame width.

y.description: Top edge as a fraction of the frame height.

width.description: Positive width as a fraction of the frame width.

height.description: Positive height as a fraction of the frame height.

focus.description: Normalised focus window (for recipe focus). x + width and y + height must stay within 1; the semantic pass reports SEM_MOTION_FOCUS_RECT when the rectangle leaves the frame.

morph.description: Bounded shape morph (for recipe morph): the renderer interpolates between two catalogue shapes.

cue_phrases.description: Narration phrases that anchor scene beats, in order. The planner resolves each against measured captions/word cues and records provenance; it falls back to an explicit diagnostic instead of claiming forced alignment. cue_seconds, when present, wins.

cue_seconds.description: Scene-local speech cue times for diagram cards, one per copy item. Explicit seconds take priority over cue_phrases. Omitted cues spread through the scene.

entry.description: Entry preset. fadeUp/maskRise/pop/countUp are the MS1 primitives of the same name (apps/renderer/src/motion/primitives.js); waterfall (kinetic words) and drawOn (SVG stroke draw-on via pathLength) are MS3. Omitted: the layout's own default entry.

ease.description: Ease for the entry; omitted: the preset's own ease (enter for tweens).

spring.description: Spring for a pop entry; omitted: pop.

stagger.description: Stagger family, exactly the keys of STAGGER_SECONDS (MS1); total stagger is capped at 0.5 s.

emphasis.description: none; keyword = highlight one word or phrase (needs `highlight`); hero = the film's one hero moment.

highlight.description: The word or phrase of this scene's copy that a keyword emphasis highlights; must appear in the copy.

energy.description: Per-scene energy override; omitted: the package motion.energy.

sceneMotion.description: MS2: per-scene motion preset and emphasis. Every field is optional and has no schema default, so an absent field means the renderer's layout default.

relativePath.description: Repository-relative POSIX path. Absolute paths, traversal, backslashes, drive letters and ~ are rejected by the semantic validator so the failure message can name the offending form.

sha256Hex.description: Lowercase hex sha256. Uppercase is rejected on purpose: hashes are compared byte-for-byte across the manifest and the package.

castId.description: CAST1 id of a cast member. See castMember.kind: fictional by default, real_authorized only with a consentRef (CCL5b).

castMember.description: CAST1: one recurring character. ref_asset is a ready still (image or svg) the FLUX 3 Klein reference edit conditions on. `kind` defaults to fictional; real_authorized requires consentRef (CCL5b).

ref_asset.description: Ready still of the character. A missing or unready asset is a semantic error.

kind.description: CCL5b: fictional means an invented character and is the default when the field is absent, so old packages stay valid. real_authorized means a real person whose consent record is named by consentRef.

consentRef.description: CCL5b: reference to the consent record for this member (for example an id in the characters.json sidecar). Required when kind is real_authorized; ignored for fictional members.

voice.description: CCL4a: this cast member's own voice. Optional. When present it is used for scenes this member speaks (scene.speaker) and is shaped like the package voice without the package-level enabled switch.

castVoice.description: CCL4a: a per-character voice in package-v1. Same fields and bounds as the package voice, minus the package switch: `enabled` is accepted for round-tripping a package voice but is not required. A missing voice means the package voice narrates.

engine.description: kokoro is the CPU narrator. qwen3-tts is the Qwen3-TTS 1.7B backend. none means this character does not speak.

lang.description: Optional short language tag for Qwen3-TTS (en or fr). When it is omitted, voice.language is used. Kokoro keeps using voice.language.

persona.description: Natural-language description used by Qwen3-TTS VoiceDesign to build this character's voice.

ref_asset.description: Designed reference clip for this character's voice.

strict.description: When true, a selected qwen3-tts runtime that is unavailable fails the run. When false or omitted, the run falls back to Kokoro.

chunking.description: Kokoro synthesis context: separate sentences (default) or a coherent scene paragraph with estimated sentence/word alignment.

blend.description: Kokoro weighted voice styles. Positive weights are normalized before synthesis.

qwen_mode.description: design (default) uses VoiceDesign then Base cloning; custom uses the CustomVoice preset named in voice.voice.

delivery.description: CustomVoice default delivery instruction, overridden by scene.narration_style. For design mode, appended to the reference persona.

non_streaming.description: Qwen full-text conditioning. Defaults to false for Base cloning and true for CustomVoice.

reference_text.description: Transcript synthesized by VoiceDesign to create the reusable synthetic reference.

license.description: Rights of the *output file* (SPEC.md 6.3). Distinct from model_license, which covers the model that produced it.

blocked.description: Set when a rights filter refused the asset (NC/ND/unknown). Blocked assets must not ship.

modelLicense.description: Licence of the *model weights*, never the output's rights.

source.description: example means invented placeholder numbers: they must be approved before a final render can cite them.

items.description: Bullet lines for the list layout.

scrim.description: Dark overlay drawn between the media and the layout text, 0 (none) to 1 (black). P-fix1 renders it in the media layer.

label.description: Optional plate label for a split or compare media item.

frame.description: LP2 inset. pip draws this item in a framed picture-in-picture (placement + mask + ring + shadow). none, and omitting the field, keep the existing panel.

placement.description: Where a pip frame sits. pip-bc is the bottom-centre spot above captions. The same names the presenter overlay uses.

mask.description: PiP mask. Omitted means rounded-rect. A 3 px brand ring and soft shadow are drawn by the renderer.

size.description: PiP size as a fraction of the frame's short side (18-32%). Omitted means 0.24. Ignored unless frame is pip.

media.description: LP2: the two plates of a split or compare scene. Each plate is a background (exactly one of asset or procedural) plus an optional label. Optional on every layout; split and compare require it.

code.description: LP2 code/terminal scene. Typing is characters per second; omitted means about 0.035 s/char. highlights are 1-based line numbers, one accent for the whole scene.

charsPerSecond.description: Characters revealed per second. Omitted means 1/0.035 (about 28.57), which is 0.035 s/char.

media_only.description: Skip this scene's layout and draw only the media layer (background media + scrim + foreground panels + lower_third). Requires a media background or a foreground item (P-fix1).

lower_third.description: Lower-third overlay, drawn by the media layer (P-fix1). Its text is bound by the same rule as copy: too long is a visible fail state, never silent clipping.

transitionOut.description: Transition into the next scene (PLAN.md A1: fades; MS2: the motion transition vocabulary). Missing transitionOut means a default fade. `direction` applies to slide | push | wipe (left/right/up/down) and zoom | iris (in/out); when it is omitted on a directional type the renderer uses the package motion.direction (the film's one current) or `in`. paper-reveal | draw-reveal | shape-reveal have no axis, so a direction on them is a lint warning. `cut` always has frames 0. lintMotion() checks budget, vector law and durations.

narration_spoken.description: Respelling sent to the synthesizer (for example Comfyrizz -> Comfy rizz). Captions keep narration. Optional; otherwise pronounce.py is applied.

spoken_text.description: Alias of narration_spoken. narration_spoken wins when both are set.

narration_style.description: Per-scene delivery instruction for Qwen CustomVoice, overriding voice.delivery. Base cloning and Kokoro do not support per-scene instructions.

presenter.description: H17: this scene's own answer about the AI presenter - off, picture-in-picture, or the intro/outro split layout. The package's `presenter.scenes` decides the default.

cast.description: CAST1: cast members that appear in this scene. Every Klein still the scene names (background or foreground) is planned as a reference edit that includes each member's ref_asset.

speaker.description: CCL4a: the cast member who speaks this scene's narration. Optional. When omitted, the package voice narrates. The speaker's cast[].voice, when present, overrides the package voice for this scene; otherwise the package voice is used.

assetVariants.description: Alternate renditions of the same asset. The asset's own `file` stays the default; a variant is what a bigger export may prefer (H12: the x2 upscale a 1920x1080 export uses instead of scaling the 1x file up again). Unknown names are left to the semantic pass, which names the rule.

crop.description: Recorded crop applied to the final plate (SPEC.md 6.4: 1920x1088 -> 1920x1080).

gen.description: Provenance of a generated asset (PLAN.md 'Generated-first assets').

generator.description: llm-svg = procedural vector written as code (CPU, free); flux3-klein = FLUX 3 Image Klein stills; ltx25 = LTX-2.5 plates; ltx25-a2v = LTX-2.5 audio-to-video (the H17 presenter, driven by a scene's narration WAV); kokoro = Kokoro narration audio; qwen3-tts = optional Qwen3-TTS 1.7B narration audio (Apache-2.0).

inputs.description: Resolved workflow inputs. Paths here are repository-relative and any value naming an asset must resolve.

sanitizer_version.description: Required for llm-svg assets (PLAN.md A5): which sanitizer produced the stored SVG.

render_check.description: CPU rasterisation check result (A5 renderCheck). Required for ready llm-svg assets and must have ok true.

kind.description: svg and vector-anim are the generated-first kinds (PLAN.md); vector-anim is a keyframed vector part whose animation is driven by the Remotion frame, not by SMIL clocks.

cutout.description: The stored image is an alpha cutout (transparent PNG), so the renderer must composite, not fill.

license.description: Output rights. Defaults for generated assets: id CC0-1.0 and redistributable true.

cast.description: CAST1: this still depicts the cast member. The planner appends that member's ref_asset to the Klein reference-edit inputs.
